{"name": "Earth-Moon Barycenter", "subtitle": "Center of mass of the Earth-Moon system", "body": "Distance from Earth center: ~4,670 km
Distance below Earth surface: ~1,700 km
Location: between outer core and lower mantle

Why this matters:
Earth WOBBLES around this point every month!
The barycenter is inside Earth (unlike Pluto-Charon
where it's outside both bodies), but the wobble
is real and measurable.

The Sun-EMB Lagrange points (L1-L5) orbit
this point, not Earth's center. JWST, SOHO,
and other spacecraft 'orbit' a point defined
by this barycenter's path around the Sun.

Mass ratio: Moon/Earth = 1.23%
Highest of any planet-moon system!
(Compare: Io/Jupiter = 0.005%)"}
